## US equity futures rise ahead of July CPI; CoreWeave and Nebius among premarket movers

AI names leading into a CPI print is a signal that sector momentum is strong enough to decouple from the near-term macro read; a hotter-than-expected print could test whether that resilience holds, making the CPI outcome a binary for the session's AI trade.

- S&P 500 and Nasdaq 100 futures are advancing as markets await the July CPI data.
- CoreWeave (CRWV) and Nebius (NBIS) are called out as notable premarket gainers.
- Super Micro is also mentioned as a mover (company name truncated in headline).
- The session combines a broadly risk-on macro setup with idiosyncratic AI-name outperformance.
